# freshdesk_business_hours (Data Source)

Look up a single business-hours calendar by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_business_hours" "example" {
  # Singular data sources take the record ID.
  # id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the business hours calendar to look up.

### Read-Only

- `business_hours` (Map of String) Working window per weekday, as a `start_time`/`end_time` JSON object.
- `created_at` (String) When the calendar was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the calendar.
- `holidays` (Map of String) Holiday dates keyed by name.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the account's default calendar.
- `name` (String) Name of the calendar.
- `time_zone` (String) Time zone the calendar is expressed in.
- `updated_at` (String) When the calendar was last changed (RFC 3339).
